messages:
alex-oncall: Seeing a brief spike in cross-region TLS handshakes failing (eu->na) after the 07:00 deploy. ~0.7% for 12m. Opening thread to track remediation.

mira-sre: thanks. can you paste one or two sample errors?

alex-oncall: sample from router logs: `tls: handshake error: timeout; src=10.3.12.8 dst=34.5.6.7 route=eu->na retries=3`

kai-neteng: checking egress now. getting repeated SYN retransmits from a subset of gateways during window 07:02-07:14. suspicious MSS options on SYN-ACKs.

joy-platform: FYI the deploy enabled session-stickiness for that service to reduce fanout; may have concentrated traffic on the affected gateways.

mira-sre: action: kai to collect pcaps + run a short tcp replay test against the gateway, upload to s3. due EOD Wed.

kai-neteng: ack. will capture and run replay on staging.

pm-ashley: we should have an automated gate: if handshake_fail_rate>0.5% for 10m during deploy, rollback. who owns that?

joy-platform: platform will own the gate. I'll add an alert + runbook automation, ETA 48h.

incident-bot: INC-5110 created: "cross-region TLS handshake spike during canary" assigned kai-neteng, mira-sre.

mira-sre: additional follow-up: add per-route handshake failure metric to Console; owner=mira-sre, PR target next Tue.

kai-neteng: quick mitigation tested on staging: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` on the gateway fixes handshake success from 99.3%->99.99% under synthetic load. uploading pcap: s3://redwood-logs/pcaps/1890123456-fix.pcap

joy-platform: wired the alert + rollback chat playbook; playbook will post to this thread if triggered. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress-handshake-failures

pm-ashley: scheduling a Fri status check and prepping customer comms if needed.

mira-sre: summary of action items: 1) kai - staging capture + validation (EOD Wed). 2) joy-platform - alert + rollback automation (48h). 3) mira-sre - per-route metric PR (next Tue) + weekly follow-ups for 3 weeks. 4) ashley - customer comms scheduling. Close after 24h prod stable.

alex-oncall: thanks all. keeping thread open for 24h post-stable. will update incident doc with links.
